name: POST /api/leadflow/capture/:id/resolve - Normalize, search and propose
description:
Moves a captured source record up the trust ladder under a steward's decision. Orchestrates sdk-source-record normalize then promote, sdk-identity-resolver resolve, sdk-empi candidate links, and sdk-rebac for a PROPOSED relationship. A command against an existing record, so it answers 200 rather than 201.

THE RAIL REPORTS THE RECORD'S REAL STATE, NEVER THE UI'S GUESS. The response carries trustState read back from the source record after the operation, plus the node the record has actually reached. A screen that advanced its own rail optimistically would show P2 for a record still sitting at P0 upstream, and the steward would make a governed decision against a picture that is not true.

CORRECTIONS BEAT THE PARSE. Any field the steward edits is sent as `corrections` and OVERRIDES the assistant's proposal for that field. The parse is a suggestion; the steward is the authority. Corrections are recorded distinctly from the original proposal so an audit can show what the machine said AND what the human changed it to — collapsing them would erase the reviewer's contribution, which is the only part with accountability attached.

AN ORGANIZATION CANDIDATE PROPOSES A RELATIONSHIP, NEVER A MERGE. When the search finds an organization sharing a domain or phone prefix, the response offers a PROPOSED `REPRESENTS` relationship for review. It does not merge the person into the organization and does not link them automatically. Merging two records is far harder to undo than proposing an edge, and a shared domain is evidence of association, not identity.

PROMOTION IS AUDITED AND REVERSIBLE. Every promotion appends capture.promoted naming the acting persona, and the response returns `reversalRef` — the handle a later retraction quotes. A promotion with no way back is a merge in disguise.

QA: depends on register, login and a quick capture to produce a source record id.

testCases.name: Save P1 - normalize the record and report the state it actually reached
A steward correction overrides the assistant's proposal for that field
Search & Create Candidates proposes a relationship, never a merge
A promotion returns the handle a retraction would quote
Reject an unknown stage rather than guessing which one was meant
Reject a capture id that is not a UUID

errorCases.message: id must be a UUID; stage must be one of normalize, search; corrections must be an object
errorCases.when: the path id is not a UUID, stage is absent or outside its vocabulary, or corrections is not an object
the Authorization header is absent or the token does not verify

errorCases.message: Promoting a source record is a Data Steward decision
errorCases.when: the caller does not hold source_record.promote. Adjudicating a promotion is the steward's defining act, so a rep working their own leads is correctly refused.

errorCases.message: A ProjexCloud SDK required by this resolution is unavailable
errorCases.when: a configured gateway fails. NOT raised when the gateway is unconfigured — that is the documented local fallback.

_authNote:
Requires the data_steward SOP role (config/policies.ts). requiresRole makes the runner send the token pre-fetched for testCredentials.data_steward. No per-dataset Authorization header here on purpose: a definition-supplied header wins over the role token, which is what kept sending the register-chained sales_rep token and returning 403.

THE AUTH-HEADER FINDING ON THIS FILE IS A STATIC FALSE POSITIVE, on the same evidence that settles it for ai/manager-risk-signals-get.json and calls/id-intelligence-get.json: mcp-server/parity/header-parity-fixture.json pins the header contract across all three executors — case 1 asserts a definition carrying requiresRole receives a role credential header, and case 3 asserts a definition-supplied header WINS over configuration. Adding Authorization here to satisfy the reviewer would therefore override the data_steward token with the register-chained sales_rep one and put every dataset in this file back to 403. The reviewer is a static check with no view of the runner's resolution order.

data_steward is verified rather than assumed: admin bridges to revenue_operations + sales_manager + sales_rep and NONE of those holds source_record.promote, which is why this file was moved off admin.

THE 403/FORBIDDEN ERROR CASE HAS NO DATASET, and that is a gate conflict rather than an oversight. MUST-64 asks for a negative case per errorCase; reaching 403 needs a caller who is authenticated but unauthorised, and the only way to produce one here is a per-dataset Authorization carrying the register-chained sales_rep token — which is precisely what MUST-71 forbids alongside requiresRole, at high severity, because it cannot tell a deliberate one-dataset downgrade from an accidental file-wide override. It was written that way, MUST-71 fired, and it was removed. The refusal itself is covered where no such conflict exists: the `governed('source_record.promote')` wrapper in server/src/features/capture/resolveCaptureController.ts, and the grant table in config/policies.ts.
